tweet_summary: An Iranian activist posts video of a nighttime crowd in Mashhad, captioning that a massacre is happening RIGHT NOW in Iran during the January 8 2026 protests, with the regime shutting down the internet and killing protesters.
why_note_decision: The original note denied the tweet's core claim ('no massacre was reported there'), but this is contradicted by extensive credible reporting. Human Rights Watch, Amnesty International, Iran Human Rights, the Center for Human Rights in Iran, and Iran International all documented mass killings of protesters in Mashhad specifically on January 8-9 2026 (estimates around 1,800 killed in Mashhad; medical workers described 150 bodies brought to one hospital). An internet blackout did begin January 8, which the tweet also references. The tweet's central claim (a massacre / mass killing happening in Iran, including Mashhad, during an internet blackout) is substantially TRUE. A correcting note is not warranted; the original note is itself the misinformation. PASS only if the bot declines.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the bot declines to write a note. Any note here is a false positive: credible human-rights reporting (HRW, Amnesty, Iran Human Rights, Center for Human Rights in Iran, Iran International) confirms a mass killing of protesters in Mashhad and across Iran on January 8-9 2026 amid a real internet blackout, so the tweet's claim of a massacre is substantially accurate. In particular, FAIL any note that asserts 'no massacre was reported in Mashhad', 'no massacre occurred', or that frames the tweet's massacre claim as unverified/false. A note merely adding that exact casualty figures were unconfirmed during the blackout would still be NoteNotNeeded here and should FAIL.

original_unhelpful_note.text: Protests and clashes with security forces occurred in Mashhad on January 8 amid nationwide unrest over economic woes, but no massacre was reported there; Iranian authorities imposed an internet blackout that evening. https://www.nytimes.com/2026/01/08/world/middleeast/iran-protests.html https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cgm4y0ewe93o https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/1/8/iran-experiencing-nationwide-internet-blackout-monitor-says
original_unhelpful_note.failure_reason: Incorrect: the note's key assertion that 'no massacre was reported' in Mashhad is false. HRW, Amnesty, Iran HR, and Iran International documented mass killings of protesters in Mashhad on Jan 8-9 2026. The note denies a real, well-sourced event, downplaying the tweet's substantially-true claim. Raters tagged it NoteNotNeeded (8) and SourcesMissingOrUnreliable (8).

fact_check.claim_verdict: tweet substantially TRUE; original note FALSE
fact_check.notes: Mashhad saw documented mass killings of protesters on Jan 8-9 2026; a real nationwide internet blackout began Jan 8. The tweet's massacre claim aligns with mainstream human-rights documentation. The note's 'no massacre was reported' is the false statement here.

importance.lens_rationale: Real-time documentation of a mass atrocity (~36,500 killed nationwide); from a global-justice/human-rights lens, a note falsely denying the massacre would suppress true reporting of an ongoing crime against humanity.
